evidence.title: Hong Kong bookstores are under threat following a string of arrests

occurrences.checkable_against: Brian Leung interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Hong Konger Brian Leung found companionship in independent bookstores, saying each had its own character.
occurrences.speaker: Brian Leung
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Fleming Cheng's interview and online browsing records
occurrences.quote_span: Before visiting Greenfield Book Store, Cheng had only managed to see the books’ covers online after bypassing Beijing’s internet censorship using a VPN.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Reader interviews and bookstore visitor records
occurrences.quote_span: Some mainland readers also visit the stores for non-political reasons, such as for their niche books or simply for their calmness.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Bookstore event listings and Hong Kong inspection records
occurrences.quote_span: Despite the pressure and increased official inspections, many pressed on, with some continuing to organize activities alongside selling books.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Lee's published works and interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Lee has written about Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement, saying the independent bookstores served as a bridge to bring works about Hong Kong to the city and connect diaspora writers to their home.
occurrences.speaker: Lee
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Hong Kong police arrest records and court filings
occurrences.quote_span: But the arrests hit Book Punch in March, Hunter Bookstore in June, and Greenfield and Have A Nice Stay in July.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Fleming Cheng interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “If the Hong Kong government desperately tries to bring every aspect of the city into close alignment with the mainland, or even to the point where the two become indistinguishable, that would be a tremendous loss for us mainlanders too,” Cheng said.
occurrences.speaker: Fleming Cheng
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenfield Book Store inventory and Fleming Cheng's account
occurrences.quote_span: At the store, he picked up a title offering a critical account of China.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Hong Kong government statements, police allegations and court filings
occurrences.quote_span: The authorities accused the booksellers of selling seditious publications, according to government statements and media reports.
occurrences.speaker: Hong Kong authorities
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Book title and historical records about the Chinese leader and 1989 Tiananmen movement
occurrences.quote_span: He stood there devouring dozens of pages from another, about a pro-reform Chinese leader who fell from power for sympathizing with the protesters during the Tiananmen Square pro-democracy movement in 1989.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Landlord correspondence and tenancy records
occurrences.quote_span: Their landlord was also reviewing whether to continue to rent the space to them after being harassed.
occurrences.speaker: anonymous bookseller
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Hong Kong police records and court documents
occurrences.quote_span: Greenfield was one of four bookstores targeted by police in just four months.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Brian Leung interview transcript and Hong Kong arrest records
occurrences.quote_span: When arrests happened at the shops he visited, he said he felt something he cherished and that Hong Kong deserved was being rejected.
occurrences.speaker: Brian Leung
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Fleming Cheng's account and Greenfield Book Store records
occurrences.quote_span: Chinese university student Fleming Cheng found the political books he had only glimpsed online in a Hong Kong bookstore last year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Lee interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “It’s now like being told very directly and cruelly that perhaps this borrowed time is coming to an end,” Lee said.
occurrences.speaker: Lee
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Have A Nice Stay closure announcement and Hong Kong arrest records
occurrences.quote_span: Another bookstore, Have A Nice Stay, set up by former journalists, had announced plans to shut down Sunday, citing “elusive red lines” and financial challenges, even before its booksellers were arrested on the same day as Greenfield’s.
occurrences.speaker: Have A Nice Stay
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Hong Kong police arrest records, court filings and 2024 national security law
occurrences.quote_span: But these spaces now are under threat following a wave of bookseller arrests over alleged sedition under a 2024 national security law .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Lee's published books and interview records
occurrences.quote_span: One Hong Kong author who moved to Taiwan and has published books there is Lee, who spoke on condition of not using their full name out of fear of government retribution.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Brian Leung interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: adding that the bookshops have not “incited” him because readers can judge for themselves.
occurrences.speaker: Brian Leung
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Greenfield Book Store announcement and lease records
occurrences.quote_span: Although bail was granted, the 50-year-old shop in July announced it would close at the end of its lease.
occurrences.speaker: Greenfield Book Store
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Iris Wang interview transcript and Hunter Bookstore sales records
occurrences.quote_span: She bought a postcard about being courageous and a manga there.
occurrences.speaker: Iris Wang
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: Iris Wang interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: University student Iris Wang from neighboring Guangdong sensed tighter control over Hong Kong.
occurrences.speaker: Iris Wang
occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview recording or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: A bookseller, who spoke on condition of anonymity for fear of government retribution, said they struggled to judge what was seditious.

occurrences.subject: Hong Kong independent bookstores
